headline: Penguins could be significant sellers at Trade Deadline
take: Daily Faceoff makes the case that Kyle Dubas and the Penguins could be significant sellers at the trade deadline, with plenty of veterans to move for future assets. The standings back up the conversation: Pittsburgh is 7-10-2 with 16 points. Our numbers make it a little less clear-cut. The Penguins have had 49% of the expected goals (the quality of chances), close to even, and they've scored 4.7 fewer goals than those chances usually return, while their goaltending has been almost exactly average. That's the profile of a middling team that has been a bit unlucky, not a bad one. It doesn't argue against selling, especially with an older core, but it does mean the record may flatter the case for a teardown a little.
